title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG SECURES A CURIOUS MEANS OF CONVEYANCE AT A FABULOUS PRICE
summary_hover: The train journey across India stops abruptly at an unfinished section of track, prompting Phileas Fogg to purchase an elephant to continue.
summary_detail: Phileas Fogg, Passepartout, and Sir Francis Cromarty travel by train across the Indian peninsula, passing dense forests and historic regions. The journey is abruptly halted at the hamlet of Kholby because the railway line is unfinished, despite newspaper reports to the contrary. Remaining calm, Fogg searches the village for alternative transport and ultimately purchases a half-domesticated elephant named Kiouni for the exorbitant sum of two thousand pounds to carry them to Allahabad.
